posture: 110 roles · 23 strong-act · 1 day-rate interim worth moving on today — afternoon refresh, every item re-opened in Chrome; 91 of the 93 morning items re-confirmed live, 2 dropped, 19 new roles added
summary: Afternoon refresh of today's file. Every one of the 93 items carried from this morning was re-opened in Chrome: 91 still resolve to live postings and two were dropped — the PetSure PetSafetyNet board advertisement expired (it has since been re-listed, so the new posting replaces it), and the Board Direction non-executive director listing now redirects to a members-only page with no public teaser left to quote. Nineteen new roles came through since 08:35, led by three strong matches: a General Manager, Finance for Australia and New Zealand with Lush at $190k-$220k, a Senior Group Financial Reporting Manager building an APAC group reporting function for a global pharmaceutical business through Sharp & Carter at circa $200k-$220k, and a day-rate Senior Regulatory Compliance Manager contract supporting a compliance uplift at Bendigo Bank through Peoplebank. Interim supply stayed thin again — beyond the Bendigo contract the only genuine day-rate find was a $1,000-a-day finance applications manager brief through Talenza — which is the familiar sign that the specialist risk and finance desks (Bluefin, Kaizen, JS Careers, KPP, Robert Half, Sharp & Carter) are filling interim work off their own registers, so being registered and CV-current with them is worth more than watching the boards. Two NSW Government roles close within 24 hours: Manager, Data & AI Governance at Service NSW (19 Aug, 10:00am) and Senior Manager, Commercial (REZ) at Transport for NSW (19 Aug). Browser-verified this run: Seek, I Work for NSW, EthicalJobs, Robert Half, Michael Page, Bluefin Resources, Kaizen Recruitment and Board Direction. AICD Directorship Opportunities and Board Direction both remain fully login-walled with no public teasers, so nothing was logged from either. Coverage is still a sample rather than the whole market — a manual look at the boards and a direct call to the interim desks remains worthwhile.

items.headline: Senior Group Financial Reporting Manager — global pharmaceutical group via Sharp & Carter, Sydney North Shore (circa $200k–$220k + super)
items.summary: A newly created senior finance leadership role reporting to the CFO, standing up and running APAC group financial reporting — consolidated group and board reporting, statutory accounts and audit deliverables.
items.so_what: Senior-manager-and-above, CFO-facing, and heavy on board reporting and statutory governance, which plays straight to your FCPA and audit-committee experience; Sharp & Carter is a fast-moving finance desk, so apply today.

items.headline: Head of Finance — venture-backed Australian consumer brand via Arkadia Talent, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Head of finance for a fast-growing Australian manufacturer selling wholesale into international markets, backed by venture capital and in a growth and change phase.
items.so_what: Head-of level with real breadth and a transformation flavour. Growth-stage businesses move quickly on hiring, so an early call helps.

items.headline: Financial Controller (contract, circa $240k) — privately owned FMCG manufacturer via ThompsonCook, Parramatta (hybrid)
items.summary: Contract financial controller engagement at a privately owned food manufacturing and distribution business in Western Sydney.
items.so_what: Strong day-rate equivalent for a contract controller role, and Western Sydney is an easy base. Contract shape matches interim appetite.

items.headline: Financial Controller — via Perigon Group, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Permanent financial controller appointment placed through a Sydney finance recruitment specialist.
items.so_what: Controller roles are a reliable base for a CPA at your level. Perigon is running several controller briefs at once, which is worth knowing.

items.headline: Senior Corporate Finance & Strategic Planning Manager — via Talent Web Recruitment, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Senior manager role combining corporate finance with strategic planning responsibilities.
items.so_what: Senior manager level with a strategy overlay — a good bridge if you want to move toward COO or CFO territory rather than deeper into risk.

items.headline: Senior Finance Manager, share-based payments & remuneration accounting — via Ambition, Sydney
items.summary: Senior finance manager role specialising in share-based payment and remuneration accounting.
items.so_what: Senior manager level and technically demanding, but narrow. Relevant if you want a specialist technical accounting credential.

items.headline: Finance & Cost Director, HumeLink East transmission project — Genus Infrastructure (NSW), Haymarket, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Director-level finance and cost control leadership on a major NSW electricity transmission project.
items.so_what: Director title on a nationally significant energy infrastructure project — energy is a named sector of strength and the project has a long runway.

items.headline: Finance Manager, Funds Management — Mirvac, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Finance manager supporting the funds management arm of a major listed Australian property group.
items.so_what: Strong brand and a funds management environment, but plain manager level puts it below your tier. Worth watching rather than chasing.

items.headline: Senior Reporting Manager (NetSuite) — property developer via NorthStone Talent Partners, Sydney
items.summary: Reporting to the finance director of a premium residential and commercial developer, this role owns group financial reporting from monthly management accounts through to board packs, combined with ERP system ownership, at $180,000 to $200,000.
items.so_what: Board-level reporting ownership plus ERP responsibility is a good blend of technical accounting and systems, and the advertiser welcomes candidates from any industry. NetSuite depth may be the deciding factor.

items.headline: Manager Finance & Commercial — Transport for NSW, Sydney City
items.summary: A full-time TfNSW role providing financial and commercial leadership and assurance across a branch, covering budgeting, forecasting and contract governance in a complex multi-project environment.
items.so_what: Transport infrastructure finance with a strong assurance and contract-governance component — close to the utilities and public-sector experience base. Applications close 23 August.

items.headline: Financial Controller — Sydney CBD via Robert Half
items.summary: Robert Half is recruiting a financial controller for a Sydney CBD-based business; the listing is live on their site with details released on contact.
items.so_what: Financial controller is a listed target title and Robert Half's Sydney finance desk moves quickly. Worth a call to get the brief rather than relying on the published ad.

items.headline: Manager, Financial Accounting — Western Sydney Local Health District, Sydney Greater West ($180,279–$201,662, closes 30 Aug)
items.summary: A NSW Health district is recruiting a manager to lead financial accounting and revenue, with an explicit brief around financial governance, compliance and continuous improvement.
items.so_what: Public-sector finance leadership with a governance and compliance emphasis at a strong salary; the plain Manager title caps it at watch, but the scope is broader than the title suggests.

items.headline: FP&A Manager — gaming and digital entertainment business via ThompsonCook, Sydney ($180k–$220k)
items.summary: A gaming and digital entertainment group is hiring an FP&A manager through a specialist finance recruiter, at a salary well above the usual band for the title.
items.so_what: Well-paid commercial finance role but a plain Manager title, so it stays a watch; the pay band suggests the scope is closer to a senior finance manager brief.

items.headline: Finance Manager — Action on Poverty, Sydney (hybrid, 2 days in office)
items.summary: An international development NFP wants a finance manager to lead its finance function and partner with the COO on financial strategy.
items.so_what: Whole-of-function ownership in a small NFP with direct COO exposure; plain Manager title caps it at watch, but it suits if you want purpose-driven work with board proximity.

items.headline: Finance Manager — St Francis Social Services, Paddington, Sydney
items.summary: A Sydney social-services organisation running youth, family and refugee support programs is recruiting a finance manager for a pivotal role in the organisation.
items.so_what: Sector is outside your core strengths and the title is plain Manager, so it is a watch — but NFP finance leadership often comes with board and audit-committee reporting.

items.headline: Manager / Senior Manager, Business Services — Grant Thornton Australia, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Grant Thornton is hiring at manager to senior manager level into its business services practice, with a stated pathway toward partnership and hybrid working.
items.so_what: Professional-services client delivery rather than in-house finance leadership — adjacent to the target rather than on it. Noted for awareness given the CPA credential and partnership track.

items.headline: Finance Business Partner Lead (temporary to December 2026) — South Eastern Sydney Local Health District, Sydney East ($137,525–$156,231, closes 30 Aug)
items.summary: A fixed-term health-district role partnering with services on budgets, forecasting and financial analysis at Health Manager Level 3.
items.so_what: Below your level and salary band — logged for awareness of NSW Health finance activity rather than as a target.

items.headline: Director Business Enablement — TAFE NSW, location negotiable across NSW incl. Sydney
items.summary: TAFE NSW is recruiting a director to lead business enablement, spanning change management, program delivery and organisational capability, at $229,693 plus super and leave loading with the location negotiable across NSW campuses.
items.so_what: Director-level, well remunerated, and squarely in the transformation and operations leadership lane, with a public-education setting that echoes the local-government and public-sector background. Applications close 30 August — build the application this week.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Group Strategy — AMP Services, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Senior manager in the group strategy function of a major Australian wealth and banking group.
items.so_what: Senior manager level with strategy breadth at a well-known financial services brand. A credible pivot away from pure risk if you want one.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Insurance — AMP Services, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Senior manager role covering the insurance portfolio within a major wealth and banking group.
items.so_what: Insurance plus senior manager level is a direct match; AMP running two senior manager briefs suggests active build-out. Worth applying to both.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Commercial (Renewable Energy Zones), term to 30 June 2028 — Transport for NSW, Sydney City
items.summary: Long fixed-term senior manager role on the commercial side of the NSW Renewable Energy Zones program, running to mid-2028.
items.so_what: Energy plus NSW government plus a nearly four-year term — an unusually long engagement for contract work. Closes 19 August, so decide in the next two days.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Optimisation & AI Enablement — MinterEllison, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Senior manager leading process optimisation and artificial intelligence enablement within a major national law firm.
items.so_what: Transformation leadership with a technology core — the software engineering degree is genuinely relevant here. A different shape of role but a real level match.

items.headline: Senior Manager, ICT Standards Development — Standards Australia, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: Standards Australia, the national peak standards body now employing over 200 people through a growth phase, is hiring a permanent senior manager to lead ICT standards development.
items.so_what: Senior Manager is core-target level and the role blends technology, stakeholder governance and technical rigour — an unusual but genuine fit for the software engineering plus governance combination.

items.headline: Head of Process Excellence — Mondiale VGL, Banksmeadow, Sydney (hybrid)
items.summary: A global freight and logistics provider operating across 19 markets is hiring a head of process excellence to drive operational improvement across its integrated logistics business.
items.so_what: A 'Head of' operations improvement mandate at a sizeable international operator. Logistics is outside the core sectors, but process and controls uplift is transferable work.

items.headline: Associate Director, Customer Operations & Transformation — THE ICONIC, Sydney
items.summary: Reporting to the chief customer and marketing officer, this role leads the transformation of THE ICONIC's customer operations into an AI-enabled, high-performing function.
items.so_what: Director-level operations and transformation leadership with a clear AI mandate and a direct line to a C-suite sponsor. E-commerce is a sector stretch from the usual base.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Centre of Excellence Digital — TAFE NSW, location negotiable across NSW incl. Sydney ($203,592)
items.summary: TAFE NSW is building a digital centre of excellence and needs a senior manager to lead it, with the role able to be based almost anywhere in the state including Sydney.
items.so_what: Senior Manager is core-target for you and the salary is strong; the digital-capability framing is education-flavoured rather than core risk or finance, which is what holds it at watch.

items.headline: Director, Portfolio Delivery and Governance — Australian Renewable Energy Agency via Xceltium, Sydney
items.summary: ARENA is standing up a new digital, data and technology operating model and wants a director to own portfolio delivery and the governance wrapped around it.
items.so_what: Director-level governance over an investment portfolio in the renewables sector — a good match for your energy/utilities background and your governance work; confirm the base-location arrangements with the recruiter.

items.headline: Corporate Services Manager — LUNA Services, Sydney
items.summary: Corporate services role working directly with the managing director on the financial, staffing, compliance and systems administration of the business, supporting site-based teams.
items.so_what: Broad generalist remit touching finance, compliance and systems, but small-business scale and below your tier. Context only.

items.headline: Director, Security and Service Operations — Australian Renewable Energy Agency via Xceltium, Sydney
items.summary: The second of ARENA's new technology leadership roles, covering security and service operations as the agency shifts technology from a maintenance function to a growth enabler.
items.so_what: Technology leadership with a security and operational-resilience core in the renewables sector; your software engineering degree plus risk background is an unusual and useful combination here.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Data & Analytics — financial services business via TOM, Sydney (hybrid, $170k–$185k + super + bonus)
items.summary: A leading financial services business is hiring a senior manager to lead an established analytics team producing management information and analytical insight for the business.
items.so_what: Senior Manager is core-target and TOM is one of the audit/risk/finance desks on your register; the data and analytics slant is a stretch from core risk, so weigh how you would pitch the fit.

items.headline: Data Quality and Digitisation Manager — Northern Sydney Local Health District, Royal North Shore Hospital ($118,821–$140,201, closes 31 Aug)
items.summary: A health-information services role leading data quality and health-records digitisation at Royal North Shore Hospital.
items.so_what: Below your level and narrowly records-focused — noted for completeness of the data-governance picture in NSW Health only.

items.headline: GRC Consultant, technology risk (day rate $800–$945) — global technology business via Michael Page, Sydney (hybrid / work from home)
items.summary: Temporary governance, risk and compliance engagement on a long-term project with a leading global technology company, offered on a day rate with hybrid or remote working.
items.so_what: The best-paid interim engagement on the list, with flexible working and a long project runway. Recruiter-held day-rate work moves within days — call Michael Page today.

items.headline: Interim Program Director, ERP implementation (to end 2027) — via Derwent Search, Western Sydney
items.summary: Interim program director engagement leading an enterprise resource planning implementation through to the end of 2027.
items.so_what: A long interim engagement combining technology delivery and executive oversight, through a firm that also runs board and CEO searches. Worth the conversation even if the role itself is a stretch.

items.headline: Finance & Corporate Services Manager (6–8 week temp) — Grain Trade Australia via Beaumont People, Sydney CBD (hybrid)
items.summary: Grain Trade Australia, the peak body for Australia's grain supply chain, needs immediate cover across finance, governance and corporate services for six to eight weeks at $75.91 to $94.89 per hour plus super, three days in the CBD office.
items.so_what: The only genuine day-rate interim to surface today: finance plus governance in a member-based industry body, immediate start. Short assignments like this fill within days, so register interest with Beaumont People now.

items.headline: Manager, Applications Services — Finance (day rate $1,000 + super, contract to 18 December 2026) — via Talenza, Macquarie Park, Sydney (3 days on site)
items.summary: A day-rate contract leading the support, operation and continuous improvement of a portfolio of finance applications through to December 2026.
items.so_what: Genuine day-rate work in the finance-systems space with an immediate start and a defined end date; the plain Manager title caps it at watch, but at $1,000 a day it is worth a call to the consultant.
